description: Re-attestation of attest/item2.r10.json (kept as history) after issue #253 changed constraints.abc_constr.driving_cell from BUFx2_ASAP7_75t_R (an excluded master) to BUFx3_ASAP7_75t_R in design/synth/slice.synth.json; the netlist was re-synthesized, the slice re-routed (same request geometry, seed 1) and the column re-assembled. Pinned by sha256 of raw bytes: the assembled column and its inputs. Layout geometry only; DRC and LVS are separate records (spec section 3). ASAP7 is predictive and nothing here is fabricated.

assembled.note: Re-assembled with `python3 layout/assemble_column.py` so the column embeds the re-routed slice stream; `--check` exits 0.

generator.note: The routed slice is reproducible from the committed netlist and the pinned lambdapdk archive; `--check` reproduces it byte-for-byte with the same seed (1), and `--check-input` confirms the tied netlist hashes to the report's provenance.input.content_hash. The netlist itself changed this pass (constraints.dont_use resynthesis, issue #228 step 1) and the report was regenerated with it; the report also records the routed DEF and post-route SPEF now persisted beside the GDS/SDF (sta/slice.sta.routed.json times them).

envelope.note: The klt-produced envelope the block manifest cites for item 2; this file is the companion stream inventory.
